spec.kitLine: Wish: ATK ▲ 46.46% of the skill user's
spec.scope: Generic ATK stat grant — not scoped to normal/charge/crit; feeds the target's effective ATK for all their damage.
spec.durationSemantics: 'continuously' + 'start of battle' = permanent passive, no durationSec, no durationShots.
spec.triggerIdentity: passive (applied at t=0 / battle start); no gate, no interval.
spec.targetSet: Exactly ONE ally: 'the king' — a kit-designated single ally, NOT all allies, NOT self. Most plausible engine mapping: alliesTopAtk{count:1, excludeSelf:true} (the highest-ATK ally, i.e. the carry under scope lock). The designation rule itself is not stated in this prose — it is a modeling choice that must be flagged.
spec.nearestWrongModel: stat 'atkPct' 46.46 (scales the TARGET's own ATK) instead of 'casterAtkPct' (46.46% of CHIME's ATK as a flat add). Chime is a Supporter (staticAtk 98,367) while the king is likely an Attacker (118,027), so atkPct over-credits by ~20%. Second-nearest: target 'allies' instead of one unit.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Filter buffApply events for stat==='casterAtkPct' sourced from chime's slot at frame 0: assert exactly ONE apply per application (single targetIdx, not 5), with value ≈ (46.46/100) × chime.staticAtk (a FLAT ATK number — harness rule: casterAtkPct is flat-resolved at apply time), and expiresFrame indicating no expiry. RED under atkPct encoding (stat key differs and value would be the raw 46.46 percentage); RED under allies targeting (5 applies).
spec.inertness: Non-king allies' effective ATK must NOT move; chime's own damage must NOT self-benefit if the king designation excludes self.

spec.scope: SCOPED to normal attacks only — 'Normal Attack Damage Multiplier' scales the normal-attack multiplier (schema stat 'normalAttackPct'), never skill/flatDamage/burst/DoT damage.
spec.durationSemantics: 'for 10 sec' = durationSec 10, wall-clock (not rounds). Refreshes every Full Burst entry, so it is live for roughly each FB window.
spec.triggerIdentity: fullBurstEnter — 'Activates when entering Full Burst' fires on ANY team FB, every rotation, regardless of whether chime cast her own burst. NOT burstCast.
spec.targetSet: The king (single ally), same designation as skill1 — not allies, not self.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Two near-misreads of equal plausibility: (a) stat 'attackDamagePct' or 'atkPct' instead of the normal-scoped 'normalAttackPct' — over-credits the king's skill/burst/proc damage; (b) trigger 'burstCast' instead of 'fullBurstEnter' — under-fires in any rotation chime doesn't personally burst.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Assert a buffApply with stat==='normalAttackPct', value 46.22, at each fullBurstStart, targeting one unit. Scope check: with the buff patched to 0 vs live, ONLY the king's normal-bucket damage moves; the king's flatDamage/burst-bucket totals are byte-identical. Trigger check: in a comp where chime is present but a patched override strips her burst (or another B2 completes the chain), the buffApply must STILL occur at FB entry — RED under a burstCast encoding.
spec.inertness: King's charge/skill/burst buckets unchanged; all non-king units unchanged; no application outside FB entries.

spec.scope: Rotation-level effect, not a stat; schema kind 'reenterStage' stage:2.
spec.durationSemantics: Instantaneous rotation-state effect on cast; no duration.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (chime's OWN burst, stage 2) — the effect exists only on rotations chime actually casts.
spec.targetSet: Rotation state (the 'all allies' header is cosmetic for this sentence); enables ANOTHER eligible Burst II unit to also cast in the same rotation.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Dropped entirely ('inert — sole B2 in fixture'), or mis-encoded as burstEligibility/fillGauge. Also plausible: encoding it so chime herself re-casts (double-dipping her own burst) instead of opening the stage for a DIFFERENT B2.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: In a comp with chime AND a second Burst II unit (e.g. crown): assert TWO stage-2 burstCast events in the same rotation (chime's, then the other B2's), followed by a stage-3 cast and fullBurstStart — the rotation still completes. RED if only one stage-2 cast occurs or if FB never starts. Inertness leg: with chime as the SOLE B2, per-rotation cast counts and FB count are identical to a no-reenterStage patch.
spec.inertness: With no second B2 in the team, FB counts and rotation timing must NOT change; chime must not cast twice herself.

spec.scope: Weapon-state modifier — maxAmmoPct 20. This IS damage (taxonomy #6): it stretches magazines, delaying reloads and raising shots fired; also lowers lastBullet frequency for last-bullet kits.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (rides chime's own burst) — NOT fullBurstEnter; in rotations another B2 bursts instead, it must not fire.
spec.targetSet: ALL allies (including self) — this header says 'Affects all allies', unlike the king-scoped lines.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Skipped as 'defensive/QoL, no damage' (the classic dropped-reload-mechanic failure), or mis-targeted to the king only because the neighboring lines are king-scoped.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Assert 5 buffApply events with stat==='maxAmmoPct' value 20 at chime's burstCast (targetIdx spanning all slots). Economy check: A/B the override with the effect zeroed — the carry's reload-event count over 180s must DIFFER (fewer reloads with the buff), and total shots fired must be ≥ the zeroed run. RED under a king-only targeting (4 missing applies) and under a skip (no reload-count movement).
spec.inertness: Outside the 10s windows, magazine size back at base; no effect in rotations where chime did not cast.

spec.scope: 'Attack Damage' = the Damage Up bucket (stat 'attackDamagePct') — additive with other support Damage-Up buffs, diluted accordingly; NOT an ATK stat grant.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (chime's own burst). Note: her burst cast itself lands pre-FB, but this is a buff, not damage — it simply starts its 10s window at cast, covering the ensuing FB.
spec.targetSet: The king only (single ally) — this second ■ header reverts to 'Affects the king'; NOT all allies.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Target 'allies' (bleeding the first header's target onto this line — over-credits the whole team by a 92.44-point Damage-Up), or stat 'atkPct' 92.44 (wrong bucket: multiplies base ATK instead of joining the diluted Damage-Up sum).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: At chime's burstCast, assert exactly ONE buffApply with stat==='attackDamagePct' value 92.44 (raw percentage — plain percentage stats keep their kit value), targetIdx == the king's slot. Bucket check: zeroing it moves the king's total while leaving the king's effective-ATK-derived buffApply values (casterAtkPct feeds) untouched. RED under allies targeting (5 applies) or atkPct encoding (different stat key/semantics).
spec.inertness: Non-king allies' Damage-Up bucket unchanged; no application on rotations chime doesn't cast.

notes: THE central shared-prior risk is the 'king' target: three of five lines target 'the king', a kit-designated SINGLE ally that has no literal TargetDef. The prose never states the designation rule; the plausible mapping is alliesTopAtk{count:1} (probably excludeSelf:true, so the Attacker carry at 118,027 static ATK is the king under scope lock), but whether it is highest-ATK, a fixed slot, or player-selected is NOT kit-derivable here — the driver must ⚑ the designation rule with its source, and a test must pin WHICH unit receives the buffs (assert targetSlug === the carry, not chime, not 5 targets). Second reconciliation point: skill2's trigger is fullBurstEnter (any team FB) while both burst-block effects are burstCast — a driver that keys all three to one trigger kind has misread one of them; the divergence only shows in a two-B2 comp, which chime's own reenterStage makes a NATURAL fixture (chime + crown both at B2). Third: fixture validity — chime is Burst II, so controlComp(carry) with chime as the B3-slot carry is invalid; she must occupy the B2 slot (replacing crown) with a real B3 present, or bursts never chain. Fourth: all four magnitudes and durations are literally kit-stated (tier DATAMINED); the only ⚑ in this kit is the king-designation rule plus the standard cadence tuple. Fifth: maxAmmoPct is the line most likely to be silently dropped as non-damage — it is load-bearing via shot economy and must carry a reload-count A/B assertion, not just a buffApply presence check.

driverReconciliation.convergence: 5/5 lines converge. Fable (blind) independently re-derived the SAME spec as the driver: S1 casterAtkPct 46.46 passive/permanent->king; S2 normalAttackPct 46.22/10s on fullBurstEnter (NOT burstCast) ->king; burst reenterStage stage2 on burstCast (enables a 2nd B2); burst maxAmmoPct 20/10s ->ALL allies; burst Loyalty attackDamagePct 92.44/10s ->king. Same nearest-wrong models (atkPct vs casterAtkPct; allies vs king; burstCast vs fullBurstEnter; dropped-reload-mechanic).
driverReconciliation.kingDesignationFlag: ACCEPTED as the one open flag. 'the king' (word_group=10091) has no literal TargetDef; the designation rule is not kit-derivable from prose alone. Driver models it as alliesTopAtk count:1 (highest STATIC ATK, the well-established in-game rule for Chime) and the test PINS the recipient (targetSlug === 'ada', the highest-staticAtk ally, computed independently in-test). Carried as a residual MEASUREMENT-GATED flag for owner confirmation, not a faithfulness defect.
driverReconciliation.excludeSelf: Driver left excludeSelf OFF (kit does not say 'except self'; owner literal-word rule). Fable guessed 'probably excludeSelf:true'. Behaviorally IDENTICAL: Chime is a low-ATK Supporter and is never the highest-staticAtk ally, so the king is never her either way. No damage moves. Documented, not changed.
driverReconciliation.maxAmmoReloadEconomy: Fable suggested a reload-count A/B for maxAmmoPct (most-likely-dropped line). Driver test PINs buffApply presence + value 20 + all-ally targeting + per-cast count (applied.length === chimeCasts * 4), which already discriminates king-only/skip counterfactuals. The line is faithfully modeled; a reload-economy A/B is a nice-to-have strengthening, not a faithfulness gap. Noted for owner.
driverReconciliation.verdict: GO (cross-family corroborated at S2b): blind fable spec == driver spec on every load-bearing line; no REAL-GOTCHA; one residual king-designation flag.
